candidates.statement: 4 Quality Defects ................................ ................................ ................................ .................. 3 A short Guideline for Marketing Authorization Holders The obligation to report Adverse Drug Reactions and all other safety issues is laid down in the Swiss Regulations HMG, VAM, and VKlin. It starts with the company’s first application at Swissmedic to notify a clinical trial (or the application for a marketi ng authorization) and ends with the expiry date of the last distributed batch. However, relevant information obtained thereafter should also be reported.
candidates.context: 3 Reporting Requirements in Swissmedic Notified Clinical Trials (CT) ............................ 3 The reporting responsibilities for marketed products lie with the Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) , and the manufacturer. The reporting responsibilities in clinical trials lie with the sponsor.

candidates.statement: ( Home > Human medicines > Market surveillance > Pharmacovigilance > Companies ) Timelines ▪ 15 days for all serious ADR ( s ) ▪ 15 days for clusters of expected or unexpected ADR(s) ▪ 60 days fo r non - serious unexpected ADR(s) Swissmedic expects ICSR s submitted by pharmaceutical companies to include a medical assessment. For each submitted ICSR , a minimum of two follow - up attempts should be made within a time period of four weeks if information relevant for case assessment is missing. For further information please refer to: FAQs: General Pharmacovigilance (swissmedic.ch) .
